q: How do I apply for the internship?
a: Register on the CodeAlpha website, pick your domain, and you will receive an offer letter by email.

q: How many tasks do I need to complete?
a: Complete at least 2 or 3 tasks from your domain. Submitting only one task is considered incomplete.

q: What does the repository have to be named?
a: Name it CodeAlpha_ProjectName and upload your complete source code to GitHub.
Yes. Completion certificates are QR verified and carry a unique ID, provided you meet the task criteria.

q: Do I get a letter of recommendation?
a: A letter of recommendation is issued based on your performance during the internship.
The internship offers a certificate, letter of recommendation and placement support. Check your offer letter for stipend details.

q: How do I submit my work?
a: Use the submission form shared in your WhatsApp group. Submissions sent anywhere else are not accepted.

q: Do I need to post on LinkedIn?
a: Yes. Share your internship status tagging CodeAlpha and post a video explanation of your project with the GitHub link.

q: Who do I contact for help?
a: Email services@codealpha.tech or message the WhatsApp number given on the CodeAlpha website.
Yes. Job opportunities, placement support and resume building support are part of the perks.

q: What happens if I miss the deadline?
a: Complete the projects within the stated time frame. Contact support early if you need an extension.

q: Which languages or libraries can I use for the AI tasks?
a: Python with libraries such as NLTK, SpaCy, OpenCV, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch are all suitable.
